name: drain-120
description: A draining API instance tells every agent to reconnect within 120 s, then closes its socket: the simulator gives every live session a drain hint of 120000 ms and closes each socket as a server going away (reported to the pacer as close code 1001; no close frame is sent). Measures how evenly the agent fleet spreads its redials (reconnectSpanS, peakToMean, peakConnectsPerSecond, t90S). The drain SENDER is the API's (W5c); this action stands in for it, so it exercises the agent side only. Not modelled: agents older than #9145 (they redial at once); use --pre-w09-fraction for the #9145 cohort, which ignores drain hints.
